ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed towards low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels; high-intensity white/beige pixels comprise less than 5% of the total surface area, primarily localized at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform black pigmentation across both lobes; discrete, high-contrast brown/white clusters located at the extreme distal tips; sparse, isolated white pixel points (1-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the mid-ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 75 degrees; notch depth accounts for approximately 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-to-mid frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges between 5 and 15 pixels relative to the mean contour line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature initiates from the median notch, transitioning into an upward convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast multi-tonal pixels (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white speckles across the central ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle growth at the distal extremities of both lobes, creating a ragged, non-linear edge profile at the tips.
